source_text: A 2025 analysis of Demographic and Health Surveys data from 2003-2023 across sub-Saharan Africa found male circumcision associated with significantly lower HIV prevalence odds (adjusted OR: 0.45, 95% CI: 0.42-0.48), correlating with program rollout and no substantial risk compensation inflating infections. [99]
